description: Traefik 3.7.15 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contains a client certificate authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider because, on hosts shared by multiple Ingresses using auth-tls-secret, Ssl-Client-* headers are built per Ingress while the TLS handshake uses the first Ingress's settings. Unauthenticated remote attackers can obtain Ssl-Client-Verify: SUCCESS with a client-chosen subject and issuer for an unverified certificate, or inject Ssl-Client-* headers directly, presenting forged identities to backends that trust the proxy.
